column3: SAMIN: «ومبثوثة: مفرقة» - plain adjective of «زرابي»; nothing contradicts OURS.
Nothing in the packet contradicts the genitive idafa after «طعام».
«المال» is the direct object of «تحبون»; Makki's paraphrase agrees.
Imperfect marfu' after «لا» (negation, not jussive); Bahr/Makki read it so.
MAKKI: «لا يوثق أحد مثل وثاق الله»; accusative object/maf'ul mutlaq both permitted; MUJTABA's view is a stated alternative.
Standard: «لم» is a negation, jussive and qalb particle; nothing contradicts OURS.
